text:
Samir Patel: FYI — Beacon Health scheduled go-live next Tue 09:00 PT. Can we draft a customer-facing one-pager + internal quick-runbook that covers prefills, batching, streaming fallback, and renewal-risk signals? Need something concise for their ops + our SREs.

Dana Ortiz: Yep. Keep customer doc short (1 page) + internal runbook with exact knobs. Important: customer must opt-in to prefill due to PHI. Add a consent flag and show how to disable prefill quickly.

Mei Wong: Drafting internal runbook now. Key sections: 1) Pre-launch warm: prefill window and limits, 2) Live ramp: adaptive batching and KV hints, 3) Streaming SLO & fallback, 4) Monitoring & renewal signals, 5) Rollback & escalation. Posting parameters below.

Mei Wong: PREFILL (internal settings):
- window: 12 minutes before expected traffic start
- max_prefill_concurrency: 2 workers per tenant
- prefill_rate_limit: 4 requests/min/tenant
- prefill_prompt_set: ["tenant-welcome","profile-sync","short-history"]
- prefill_kv_prefix: "tenant:beacon-887:*"
- prefill_kv_ttl: 20m
- consent_required: true (account.prefill_consent = true)

Leo Park: BATCHING + CACHE hints:
- target_batch_size: 6 (auto-adjust between 4-12 based on latency)
- batching_backpressure_threshold: 1200ms (if avg token latency > threshold, reduce batch_size)
- embedding_cache_ttl: 6h (use for reused lookups)
- prefix_cache_hit_weight: increase priority for requests with cached embeddings

Mei Wong: STREAMING SLO & FALLBACK RULES:
- desired p95 token latency < 300ms for stream to stay enabled
- if p95 > 600ms for 5m OR error_rate > 2% for 10m -> flip stream_enabled=false for tenant and route to non-stream endpoint
- when stream is disabled, send event: stream_fallback with reason code (latency|errors|manual)

Samir Patel: Monitoring + Renewal signal mapping (CS-owned):
- onboarding_utilization: expected_usage vs actual. Flag as onboarding_risk when actual < 15% expected by day 7
- activation_errors: sustained error_rate > 2% for 24h -> onboarding_risk true
- low_engagement_signal: daily active users < 10 for 5 consecutive days in first 14 days
- negative_feedback_count: 3+ support escalations within 30d
- Expose account.webhooks["onboard_flag"] (values: ok|at_risk|opt_out)

Dana Ortiz: Add a short curl we can share with SRE to toggle prefill/consent quickly.

eng-oncall: Here's a quick toggle endpoint (ops only):
```
# enable prefill
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/tenants/beacon-887/prefill_toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enable":true}'

# set consent flag
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/tenants/beacon-887 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prefill_consent":false}'
```

Mei Wong: CLIENT GUIDANCE (share with Beacon):
- Use streaming (SSE or WebSockets) for progressive UI. Accept partial chunks and render progressively.
- Implement exponential backoff with jitter for SSE reconnects. Example snippet (python):
```
import time, random
attempt=0
while True:
  try:
    connect_stream()
    attempt=0
  except StreamError:
    attempt+=1
    wait = min(30, (2**attempt) + random.random())
    time.sleep(wait)
```
- If using streaming, add a client-side 10s aggregate timeout to fall back to non-streamed call if no tokens received.

Leo Park: Fallback UX guidance: show skeleton + partial responses. If stream falls back server-side, include metadata field "fallback_reason" so client can surface a small banner.

Samir Patel: ROLLBACK & ESCALATION:
- Manual rollback: ops can flip prefill and streaming flags, or set tenant to maintenance mode which routes to stable small-model endpoint.
- Escalation: page eng-oncall if onboarding_risk=true AND error_rate>5% for 30m.

Dana Ortiz: RENEWAL TOUCH template (short) to use if at_risk triggered:
Subject: Quick check-in on Beacon Health onboarding
Body: "Hi {{name}}, we noticed your account is underutilizing the integration. Can we schedule a 20-min call to help with setup and share best practices? If you prefer, we can pause prefill/streaming until issues are resolved."

Mei Wong: TELEMETRY names to add: prefill.request, prefill.success, cache.hit, cache.miss, batch.size, stream.enabled, stream.fallback, onboarding.risk_flag, tenant.maintenance_mode

CS-Bot: Reminder: Draft saved -> https://rw-internal.atlassian.net/beacon-onboard-runbook (team access: customer-success, eng-runtime, eng-oncall).

Samir Patel: ACTIONS: Dana -> create the 1-page customer-facing doc and include the Python SSE snippet; Leo -> add telemetry ticket and update metrics dashboard; Mei -> add runbook to docs and include curl toggles; eng-oncall -> make sure toggle endpoint is ready and RBAC is limited.

Dana Ortiz: I will post the customer page here by EOD Fri. :white_check_mark:
